name: portals-platform
description: Capability-first infrastructure platform for composable entertainment channels.

scripts.prepare: test -d .git && husky || echo 'Skipping Husky (Not a local Git repo)'
scripts.release:check: turbo run lint test --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/stubs/*' && node --test scripts/package-release.test.mjs && node scripts/check-package-packs.mjs
scripts.release: npm run release:build && npm run release:check && changeset publish
